# Soul Virtues Extractor
> The free 66-question Undertale soul trait assessment and multi-dimensional virtue calculator. Discover your exact percentage distribution across Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance.

Soul Virtues Extractor provides an interactive, client-side psychometric personality quiz based on the 7 human soul traits from Undertale. It features 66 carefully weighted statements, instant 7-trait breakdown, and shareable soul result cards.

## 核心内容
- [灵魂美德测试](https://soulvirtues.org/)：免费 66 题灵魂美德在线测验与即时分析
- [七种灵魂特质](https://soulvirtues.org/#virtues)：决心、勇气、正义、善良、耐心、正直与毅力的深度解析
- [计分系统说明](https://soulvirtues.org/#scoring)：66 题多维度权重与非线性归一化计算原理
